summary: Village Farms International filed a prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 7,500,000 common shares at $2.00 per share to institutional investors, raising $15 million. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acts as placement agent earning a 5.5% cash fee. Shares are Nasdaq-listed; the offering is priced at a 19% discount to the prior close. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5), not a special situation. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or restructuring is present. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situations event.
